headlines.description: — Josh Doan scored twice for his second multi-goal game of the season, Alex Tuch had a career-high four assists and the Buffalo Sabres routed the Chicago Blackhawks 9-3 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Doan scores twice, Tuch adds 4 assists to help Sabres rout Blackhawks 9-3

headlines.description: — Filip Gustavsson made 19 saves for his second shutout of the season, Matt Boldy had two goals and an assist and the Minnesota Wild beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 5-0 on Friday night for their fourth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gustavsson makes 19 saves, Wild beat Penguins 5-0 for 4th straight victory

headlines.description: — Jordan Staal scored twice and the Carolina Hurricanes beat Winnipeg 4-3 on Friday night in the Jets' first game since learning star goalie Connor Hellebuyck will be sidelined four to six weeks.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Staal scores twice in Hurricanes' 4-3 victory over Jets

events.name: Boston Bruins at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Morgan Geekie scored his second goal of the game at 2:27 of overtime to tie for the NHL goals lead and give the Boston Bruins a 2-1 victory over the Los Angeles Kings on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Morgan Geekie scores twice to tie for NHL goals lead, Bruins beat Kings 2-1 in OT
